work.title: Twelfth Night; or, What You Will
work.author: William Shakespeare

scene.label: Act 3, Scene 2
scene.title: SCENE II. A Room in Olivia's House.

content.text: Enter Sir Toby, Sir Andrew and Fabian.

lines.text: No, faith, I'll not stay a jot longer.
lines.plainText: No faith I'll not stay a jot longer

lines.text: Thy reason, dear venom, give thy reason.
lines.plainText: Thy reason dear venom give thy reason

lines.text: You must needs yield your reason, Sir Andrew.
lines.plainText: You must needs yield your reason Sir Andrew

lines.text: Marry, I saw your niece do more favours to the Count's servingman than ever she bestowed upon me; I saw't i' th' orchard.
lines.plainText: Marry I saw your niece do more favours to the Count's servingman than ever she bestowed upon me I saw't i' th' orchard

lines.text: Did she see thee the while, old boy? Tell me that.
lines.plainText: Did she see thee the while old boy Tell me that

lines.text: As plain as I see you now.
lines.plainText: As plain as I see you now

lines.text: This was a great argument of love in her toward you.
lines.plainText: This was a great argument of love in her toward you

lines.text: 'Slight! will you make an ass o' me?
lines.plainText: 'Slight will you make an ass o' me

lines.text: I will prove it legitimate, sir, upon the oaths of judgment and reason.
lines.plainText: I will prove it legitimate sir upon the oaths of judgment and reason

lines.text: And they have been grand-jurymen since before Noah was a sailor.
lines.plainText: And they have been grandjurymen since before Noah was a sailor

lines.text: She did show favour to the youth in your sight only to exasperate you, to awake your dormouse valour, to put fire in your heart and brimstone in your liver. You should then have accosted her, and with some excellent jests, fire-new from the mint, you should have banged the youth into dumbness. This was looked for at your hand, and this was balked: the double gilt of this opportunity you let time wash off, and you are now sailed into the north of my lady's opinion; where you will hang like an icicle on Dutchman's beard, unless you do redeem it by some laudable attempt, either of valour or policy.
lines.plainText: She did show favour to the youth in your sight only to exasperate you to awake your dormouse valour to put fire in your heart and brimstone in your liver You should then have accosted her and with some excellent jests firenew from the mint you should have banged the youth into dumbness This was looked for at your hand and this was balked the double gilt of this opportunity you let time wash off and you are now sailed into the north of my lady's opinion where you will hang like an icicle on Dutchman's beard unless you do redeem it by some laudable attempt either of valour or policy

lines.text: And't be any way, it must be with valour, for policy I hate; I had as lief be a Brownist as a politician.
lines.plainText: And't be any way it must be with valour for policy I hate I had as lief be a Brownist as a politician

lines.text: Why, then, build me thy fortunes upon the basis of valour. Challenge me the Count's youth to fight with him. Hurt him in eleven places; my niece shall take note of it, and assure thyself there is no love-broker in the world can more prevail in man's commendation with woman than report of valour.
lines.plainText: Why then build me thy fortunes upon the basis of valour Challenge me the Count's youth to fight with him Hurt him in eleven places my niece shall take note of it and assure thyself there is no lovebroker in the world can more prevail in man's commendation with woman than report of valour

lines.text: There is no way but this, Sir Andrew.
lines.plainText: There is no way but this Sir Andrew

lines.text: Will either of you bear me a challenge to him?
lines.plainText: Will either of you bear me a challenge to him

lines.text: Go, write it in a martial hand, be curst and brief; it is no matter how witty, so it be eloquent and full of invention. Taunt him with the licence of ink. If thou 'thou'st' him some thrice, it shall not be amiss, and as many lies as will lie in thy sheet of paper, although the sheet were big enough for the bed of Ware in England, set 'em down. Go about it. Let there be gall enough in thy ink, though thou write with a goose-pen, no matter. About it.

lines.text: Where shall I find you?
lines.plainText: Where shall I find you

lines.text: We'll call thee at the cubiculo. Go.
lines.plainText: We'll call thee at the cubiculo Go

lines.text: This is a dear manikin to you, Sir Toby.
lines.plainText: This is a dear manikin to you Sir Toby

lines.text: I have been dear to him, lad, some two thousand strong, or so.
lines.plainText: I have been dear to him lad some two thousand strong or so

lines.text: We shall have a rare letter from him; but you'll not deliver it.
lines.plainText: We shall have a rare letter from him but you'll not deliver it

lines.text: Never trust me then. And by all means stir on the youth to an answer. I think oxen and wainropes cannot hale them together. For Andrew, if he were opened and you find so much blood in his liver as will clog the foot of a flea, I'll eat the rest of th' anatomy.
lines.plainText: Never trust me then And by all means stir on the youth to an answer I think oxen and wainropes cannot hale them together For Andrew if he were opened and you find so much blood in his liver as will clog the foot of a flea I'll eat the rest of th' anatomy

lines.text: And his opposite, the youth, bears in his visage no great presage of cruelty.
lines.plainText: And his opposite the youth bears in his visage no great presage of cruelty

lines.text: Look where the youngest wren of nine comes.
lines.plainText: Look where the youngest wren of nine comes

lines.text: If you desire the spleen, and will laugh yourselves into stitches, follow me. Yond gull Malvolio is turned heathen, a very renegado; for there is no Christian that means to be saved by believing rightly can ever believe such impossible passages of grossness. He's in yellow stockings.
lines.plainText: If you desire the spleen and will laugh yourselves into stitches follow me Yond gull Malvolio is turned heathen a very renegado for there is no Christian that means to be saved by believing rightly can ever believe such impossible passages of grossness He's in yellow stockings

lines.text: And cross-gartered?
lines.plainText: And crossgartered

lines.text: Most villainously; like a pedant that keeps a school i' th' church. I have dogged him like his murderer. He does obey every point of the letter that I dropped to betray him. He does smile his face into more lines than is in the new map with the augmentation of the Indies. You have not seen such a thing as 'tis. I can hardly forbear hurling things at him. I know my lady will strike him. If she do, he'll smile and take't for a great favour.

lines.text: Come, bring us, bring us where he is.
lines.plainText: Come bring us bring us where he is
